info.title: Totalis Hyperliquid API
info.description:
REST API for Totalis singles and parlays on Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets, for client integrations and external market makers.

Authenticate with a scoped API key created in the Totalis app, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Public market reads need no key. Balance-affecting commands also carry the wallet or maker signature the HyperEVM contract verifies.

Amounts are base-10 strings in native USDC atomic units, large identifiers are decimal strings, and every command `POST` requires an `Idempotency-Key` header.

Every error is `{error: {code, message, retry, request_id, field_violations}}`. `code` is stable; each operation lists the codes it returns per status. `retry` is `NEVER` (stop), `BACKOFF` (resend the same request with the same `Idempotency-Key` after `Retry-After` seconds) or `REFRESH` (re-read state, then send a new request with a new key). `field_violations` names invalid inputs by JSON pointer, such as `/legs/0/stake`.

post.description:
Accept one offer from the RFQ's book and wait for the maker. For an ENTRY RFQ, taker_signature is the TakerAccept signature over the quote; for a CASHOUT RFQ it is the owner's SellBack or CashoutTransfer signature over quote_digest, and funding is not allowed. The response is held until the maker answers or the fixed two-second deadline passes, bounded by that deadline plus one second, and is never AWAITING_MAKER: COMMITTED with operation_id, CONFIRMED while the HyperCore funding of an ENTRY is pending, or DECLINED, TIMED_OUT or WITHDRAWN. COMMITTED means the trade, sell-back or transfer is durably queued; follow EXECUTION_REPORT on the stream. attempt_id must equal Idempotency-Key; replay returns the same result and never restarts the deadline.

Requires a personal key with `ticket:accept`.

Also requires `sponsorship:use` when Totalis pays the gas.

Also requires `funding:deposit` when the request includes a funding authorization.

Also requires `ticket:cashout` when the RFQ is a cash-out.

post.description:
The selected maker confirms with its signature over the selected ENTRY Quote or CASHOUT SellBack or CashoutTransfer terms, or declines. Confirming admits execution atomically: the entry accept, sell-back or transfer is queued with the taker's signature from the begin, and the attempt becomes COMMITTED with operation_id. A Core-funded ENTRY returns CONFIRMED while its HyperCore payment is pending, then COMMITTED after execution admission or WITHDRAWN when the attempt ends. Late responses cannot reopen a closed attempt. Maker backing remains reserved while its signature can execute. Pending requests arrive as CONFIRMATION_REQUESTED on the maker stream and in the maker snapshot's confirmations.

Requires a maker key with `quote:write`.

get.description: Requires a personal key with `identity:read`.

WebSocket upgrade for authenticated, principal-scoped committed updates. Browser clients request the `totalis.realtime.v1` subprotocol plus `auth.<base64url-access-token>`; non-browser clients may send the `Authorization: Bearer` header instead. After the upgrade, send a hello frame; the stream then delivers a snapshot or replay followed by live events, as described in the realtime stream reference. HTTP resource reads and maker snapshot/replay are recovery paths. API keys stream the one account they are bound to. A dashboard session streams its personal account, or names a maker it belongs to with maker_id; all four financial read permissions are required. Membership revision or controller epoch changes close the connection. RFQ detail subscriptions remain transport-credential only.

Requires one of:

- a personal key with `account:stream`
- a maker key with `rfq:read`
- a maker key with `vault:read` and the maker permissions `READ_ACTIVITY`, `READ_CAPITAL`, `READ_PERFORMANCE`, `READ_POSITIONS`
- a maker key with `quote:read`
- a personal key with `rfq:read`

Also requires `replay:read` to resume from a cursor or replay retained events.

Each key receives only the frames its scopes allow, and other frame classes are denied:

| Frames | Key | Needs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open RFQ discovery | personal key | `rfq:read` |
| Account | personal key | `account:stream` |
| RFQ | maker key | `rfq:read` |
| Quote | maker key | `quote:read` |
| Account | maker key | `vault:read` and the maker permissions `READ_CAPITAL`, `READ_POSITIONS`, `READ_ACTIVITY`, `READ_PERFORMANCE` |

valid_before.description: EIP-3009 validBefore in Unix seconds: at least 300 seconds after vault_withdrawal.expiry (or after now when there is no shortfall), so the payout can still be relayed once the vault leg lands, and at most 4500 seconds after valid_after.

authorization_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA signature by account over the USDC TransferWithAuthorization(from=account, to=destination, value=amount, validAfter, validBefore, nonce) message.

attempt_id.description: Client-chosen UUIDv7 for this attempt; equals the Idempotency-Key of the begin request.

account.description: Taker account the stake is funded for; the caller's embedded wallet, equal to from.

from.description: USDC payer that signed the authorization; must be the caller's embedded wallet.

quote_digest.description: EIP-712 digest of the maker quote being accepted.

taker_signature.description: Taker's EIP-712 TakerAccept signature over the quote, as in an ordinary selection.

value.description: Atomic USDC (6 decimals) drawn from the wallet into the vault. It must equal the exact stake shortfall over free vault cash at admission, or the wallet part of a Combined funding.

valid_after.description: EIP-3009 validAfter in Unix seconds; must not be in the future.

valid_before.description: EIP-3009 validBefore in Unix seconds; must be at least 5 seconds ahead and at most 900 seconds after valid_after.

salt.description: Random 32 bytes; the EIP-3009 nonce is keccak256(abi.encode(vault, chainId, from, salt, account)).

authorization_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA signature by from over the USDC ReceiveWithAuthorization message, with the vault as payee.

deadline.description: Server-set instant, two seconds after the attempt began, by which the maker must answer, as an RFC3339 UTC timestamp. Absent only for an attempt recovered from a legacy selection.

operation_id.description: Venue operation that executes the trade; present only when state is COMMITTED.

quote_digest.description: Digest of the selected ENTRY quote or CASHOUT bid.

state.description: AWAITING_MAKER: waiting for the maker. COMMITTED: the maker confirmed and execution was admitted as operation_id. CONFIRMED: the maker signed an ENTRY whose HyperCore funding is still pending. DECLINED: the maker declined. TIMED_OUT: the maker did not answer by deadline. WITHDRAWN: the offer or RFQ stopped being available first, or the HyperCore funding failed.

CacheControl.description: Always `no-store`; account data must not be cached.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before resending the same request

Vary.description: The response varies by the Authorization header, so shared caches must not reuse it across credentials.

apiKey.description: Scoped API key from the Totalis app settings. Personal keys act for one account; maker keys act for one maker. Each operation lists the scopes it requires.
